input_equivalence.basis: Only loopback phone clean-stop lifecycle source and its extracted-method regression test change. Dependency declarations, lockfiles, versions, vendored sources and provenance, model assets, licences, notices, and workflows remain unchanged. All six prior resolved inventories remain byte-for-byte unchanged. No new dependency resolution, advisory scan, or installed-runtime qualification is claimed.

qualification.scope: Bounded loopback clean-stop lifecycle source correction and synthetic extracted-method checks; no full Pipecat integration, carrier/live-call, installed-app, build, release, or deployment acceptance.
qualification.source_integrity: Exactly two reviewed public-owned source/test paths plus this canonical manifest and binding change. All 2497 source files are inventoried. All other repository bytes, modes and types, including licences, notices, provenance, dependencies, workflows and all six retained SBOMs, are preserved. Strict patch apply and reverse checks pass.
qualification.lifecycle_checks: 16 controls compile selected actual watchdog, end_call, stop, _stop_once, media-stop simulation, and terminal speech-guard method bodies unchanged, with inert media runner, storage and carrier boundaries. All 16 pass in the independently reviewed R3 and exact-byte integrated candidate.
qualification.behavior: A clean media-stop invokes the existing drain/finalization path. Abnormal loss remains FAILED. Per-session serialization and success latching prevent repeated successful recording, trace and completion effects and preserve terminal time across repeated or concurrent stop calls. Failed or cancelled cleanup remains retryable. Previously delivered owner cancellation may finish finally cleanup; a new cancellation propagates while the shared runner is shielded.
qualification.negative_controls: Independent review observed three baseline failures, six R1 failures, and the R2 ordinary-cancelled-owner-finally regression. Exact R3 source passes the original duplicate-finalization and cancelled-owner probes. Superseded candidates are not publication inputs.
qualification.lint: Installed Ruff checks pass for both changed public Python files; Black passes the new regression test. No clean whole-runtime Black or whole-repository lint claim is made.
qualification.integration_limit: Actual constructor/start wiring, full Pipecat PipelineTask/PipelineRunner, audio/model behavior, carrier WebSocket execution, persistence integration and user-facing live-call behavior are not qualified by these extracted-method controls. Full integration collection was blocked by missing optional runtime dependencies in the bounded local environment.
qualification.side_effect_limit: Retry controls use synthetic fail-before-success boundaries. They do not establish transactional exactly-once semantics for external operations that commit before reporting failure.
qualification.installed_candidate: pending; native audio/model and live phone behavior remain unverified
